oneLine: Readily Solutions plans an IPO in FY28 after converting to a public company.

sources.title: Readily Solutions plans IPO in FY28 after converting to public company; H1 revenue up 157%

synopsis: Gurugram-based clean energy company Readily Solutions Limited is planning an initial public offering in fiscal year 2027-28, subject to market conditions and regulatory approvals. The company, formerly known as Readily Mobility Solutions Private Limited, converted to a public limited company in August 2026. Founder, CEO and Director Mr. Hiteshh Sharma stated that the company is currently focused on strengthening its corporate governance, financial reporting, compliance framework, and business fundamentals ahead of the proposed listing. For the April-September period of 2026, the company reported a taxable revenue of Rs 24.47 crore, marking a 157.2 percent increase compared to the previous year, following a revenue of about Rs 115 crore in the 2025-26 fiscal year.
